title: Export a schematic or project via an external DLL
summary: Resolves the focused project or the active schematic sheet or schematic library and hands it to the third-party SIMetrixExporter.DLL through its ExportToSimetrix export, loaded at run time. Shows how to pass an Altium Designer document to native code.
phrasings: call a native DLL with the active document
export the focused project to a simulator
get the focused project and its document kind
pass an IServerDocument to unmanaged code

commands.name: ExportProjectToSimetrix
commands.description: Export the focused project via SIMetrixExporter.DLL (target <Out>\SXPRJ, format SXPRJ)

commands.name: ExportFileToSimetrix
commands.description: Export the active schematic sheet (SXSCH) or schematic library (SXLIB) via SIMetrixExporter.DLL
